newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BARCELONA BEAT REAL MADRID 1-0.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BARCELONA BEAT REAL MADRID 1-0.

Real Madrid: 25-Bodo Illgner, 3-Roberto Carlos, 4-Fernando Hierro, 6-Fernando Redondo, 7-Raul Gonzalez, 8-Predrag Mijatovic, 9-Davor Suker (21-Ze Roberto 71), 10-Clarence Seedorf, 17-Christian Panucci, 18-Rafael Alkorta, 26-Victor Sanchez (11-Emilio Amavisca 46).
